swept: hn (48h), reddit rss (5 of 8 subs), github, last30days (--days 3, nothing usable)

candidates.name: lag-writer
candidates.tagline: A writing assistant that trails a few words behind you, fixing typos and apostrophes. Runs from a single HTML file. Grammarly wanted $12 a month for the apostrophes.

grudge.quote: Built because the real ones cost money.

candidates.why: explicit grudge (3) · price verified on grammarly.com (2) · solo (2) · one thing (1) · AI use not stated (0). License not specified in repo, worth a look.

candidates.name: PiNozCam for Moonraker
candidates.tagline: AI spaghetti detection for your 3D printer that runs on the printer. No frames uploaded, no monthly fee for watching your own camera.

grudge.quote: The alternative products in this space upload every frame to a server and charge a monthly fee.

candidates.why: explicit grudge (3) · price from Obico's own blog (2) · solo (2) · one thing (1) · AI use not stated (0). AGPL-3.0.

candidates.name: Sageling
candidates.tagline: A local AI assistant for Mac running Qwen 3.5 in-process. Free, private, and it doesn't run out at 3pm like the $20 plans do.

grudge.quote: I don't wanna pay a bunch of money for it, and the $20 plans run out real fast.

candidates.why: grudge quoted from the Show HN (3; it's his friends' words, relayed) · price secondary (1) · solo (2) · one thing (1) · not open source, not vibe coded (0)

candidates.name: Locan
candidates.tagline: Seven local SEO checks that rank trackers charge $39 a month to run against public Google data. No account, no card, no "upgrade to see the rest".

grudge.quote: The pattern that annoyed me most: owners paying monthly for 'rank trackers' and 'GBP optimizers' that just resell public Google Places data behind a subscription.

candidates.why: explicit grudge (3) · price secondary (1) · one contributor (2) · seven tools, not one thing (0) · AI use not stated (0). AGPL-3.0.

candidates.name: ENZO
candidates.tagline: A self-hosted AI workspace where you bring your own API keys and nobody sits in the middle taking $20 a month.

grudge.quote: I use AI daily, but every app around it wants a subscription.

candidates.why: explicit grudge (3) · price secondary (1) · solo (2) · chat, research, code and agents, not one thing (0). Apache-2.0. Victim is generic "hosted AI apps"; ChatGPT Plus chosen from its own comparison table.
